datasets.title: CrossNER target-domain NER
datasets.split_policy: Use original train/dev/test and original document identity; exclude CoNLL Reuters from this target-domain suite.
limitations: BIO tokens require explicitly versioned text reconstruction; report this separately from immutable original-text offset tests.
Keep all domain ontology types, including miscellaneous; never infer per-document query labels from gold.
Overlap with CrossRE and its translations must share a global leakage family.

datasets.title: MultiCoNER 2 multilingual/noisy NER
datasets.split_policy: Use original splits and noise/source identifiers; keep original and noisy versions together.
limitations: S3 data object bytes/version are not locked yet; published 12-language/noise metadata alone does not pin corpora.
Report clean and noisy examples separately with all 36 fine-grained labels; token-based reconstructed-text scope.
Primary registry declares CC BY 4.0; preserve dataset citation and notices.

datasets.title: SemEval-2014 Task 4 aspect terms and polarity
datasets.split_policy: Use official train and labeled phase-B test; derive calibration only from grouped training reviews.
limitations: Explicit from/to occurrences support repeated aspect terms; verify XML decoded text offsets byte-for-byte.
All four polarity labels, including conflict and neutral, are declared globally.
Do not pass gold aspect spans to the end-to-end worker. Gold-span conditional accuracy is a separate diagnostic.
Organizer download terms and corpus byte pins must be recorded before acquisition; do not assume a permissive mirror license.

datasets.title: MASSIVE 1.1 intent/scenario/slots
datasets.split_policy: Original partition; all locales sharing the same utterance ID form one family.
limitations: Use all 60 intents and 55 slot types; derive intent-to-scenario implication mapping from the declared ontology/training only.
Treat scenario as a separately predicted task when testing constraints; never feed its gold value into inference.
Preserve utt exactly; parse annot_utt to locate spans and verify complete unannotated text reconstruction.
README pins the release URL but corpus archive bytes are still unlocked; NOTICE declares data CC BY 4.0.

datasets.title: GoEmotions multilabel classification
datasets.split_policy: Use rater-agreement train/dev/test; same comment/thread and duplicate text must not cross splits.
limitations: Keep all 28 labels and official label order. Gold labels are not a schema.
Any Ekman/higher-level task is a named derived evaluation, with fixed mapping provenance; do not silently reinterpret official scores.
Complete annotation and neutral exclusivity must be audited before imposing a hard constraint.

datasets.title: CrossRE and Multi-CrossRE
datasets.split_policy: Original splits; source doc_key shared across CrossNER, all translations and back-translations is one family.
limitations: Evaluate end-to-end predicted endpoints separately from official gold-entity relation classification.
Machine translated corpus and native-speaker-checked subset are distinct slices.
JointIE typed endpoint/graph validity can be tested; no domain-wide functional or acyclic constraint may be invented from one gold example.
Repository license is GPL-3.0; record data-specific terms separately and do not copy baseline implementation into native runtime.

datasets.title: Re-DocRED document-level relations
datasets.split_policy: Use official revised train/dev/test and source Wikipedia document identity; audit original DocRED overlap.
limitations: Score cluster triples only after mapping predicted mentions to gold clusters in the evaluator. No gold clusters/endpoints enter inference.
One arbitrary mention per cluster is not a valid occurrence-level ground truth.
Documents span multiple sentences; measure actual 4096-word overflow coverage rather than assuming this tests the native long-window extension.
Underlying Wikipedia/DocRED data terms and exact revised file bytes remain to be locked.

datasets.title: WikiEvents natural event records
datasets.split_policy: Use official train/dev/test; document and coreference-family IDs remain together.
limitations: Declare full event/role ontology per frozen schema; do not choose event types from test annotations.
Natural anchor is the explicit event trigger; reference argument extraction with gold triggers is a separate task, not end-to-end record extraction.
Full-span and head/coreference official scoring differ; preserve both metric identities.
S3 corpus objects are mutable URLs until exact bytes/version and terms are locked.

datasets.title: Doc2EDAG / ChFinAnn trigger-free event tables
datasets.split_policy: Use official document splits and announcement/company/document families.
limitations: Distant supervision and semantic event tables can omit occurrence identity; qualify semantic records only unless occurrence annotations are added.
Run latent and anchorless modes as separate frozen model/schema profiles against identical record gold; never manufacture a natural trigger.
Keep repeated record multiplicity; exact record matching must not collapse a multiset into a set.
Long-window coverage must be measured from actual source word/token lengths; reconstructed text policy must be pinned.

datasets.title: DuEE-Fin records with enumerated attributes
datasets.split_policy: Use published training/dev splits; held-out test labels/download access must be verified with the original competition.
limitations: Primary baseline explicitly separates trigger, arguments and source-free enum role 环节.
Freeze all 13 event types, role cardinalities and enum vocabulary from released ontology/training before evaluation.
A labeled accessible holdout is not established by the README. If test gold is unavailable, split grouped training/dev prospectively and label result as derived.
Removing triggers for latent/anchorless evaluation is an explicit schema ablation, not the official task.

remaining_before_runs: Acquire authorized exact corpus bytes and preserve per-file digests/notices.
Implement and review deterministic dataset adapters and official metric mappings.
Freeze schemas, prompts, thresholds and decoder/window settings on training/calibration only.
Audit global document, translation, normalized-duplicate and benchmark-smoke exclusion groups.
Execute actual labeled holdouts with model/bundle/backend/token provenance and complete coverage.
Run grouped paired bootstrap and freeze task/slice-specific quality floors before opening final test results.
pretraining_contamination_status: unknown; local split audit cannot prove synthetic teacher/pretraining exclusion
